name: WdTextOrientation
description: Specifies the text direction in a range or selection.

constants.name: wdTextOrientationUpward
constants.description: Text flows upward on a slope.

constants.name: wdTextOrientationDownward
constants.description: Text flows downward on a slope.

constants.name: wdTextOrientationVerticalFarEast
constants.description: Text flows vertically and reads downward from the top, right to left.

constants.name: wdTextOrientationHorizontalRotatedFarEast
constants.description: Text flows horizontally but from right to left to accommodate right-to-left languages.

constants.name: wdTextOrientationVertical
constants.description: Text flows vertically and reads downward from the top, left to right.
